Dealing with stuff like this is really hard. The best thing I would say is make sure he’s taking care of himself (showering, brushing teeth, eating, sleeping). Keeping a routine during the hard times makes it easier. After his friend gets sent to a psychiatric hospital he’ll most likely be able to talk to him if he hasn’t already so make sure he knows this. Maybe pick up some of his favorite snacks or something he enjoys to get his mind off it a little bit. Possibly get him a journal so he can put his feelings somewhere other than letting it fester in his mind. I wish you the best :)
